high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from Dr. S. Jaishankar, who is verified on Twitter (@DrSJaishankar). The tweet was posted 23 hours prior to the screenshot being taken at 1:41 PM. The tweet congratulates Shri @ombirlakota ji on once again being elected as the Speaker of the Lok Sabha. The content of the tweet highlights that Shri @ombirlakota ji's experience and equanimity continue to guide the House and ensure that parliamentary democracy delivers. It concludes with best wishes for a successful tenure. The tweet was posted at 2
